title: Episode 084 — Ask Asa / Pooner and Heather Phone Sex
summary: Episode 84 restores Ask Asa as a sustained listener-question format. Its strongest material is Asa Akira's first-person account of directing, performance logistics, relationship change, menstruation on set, audience questions, and the difference between public fantasy and private intimacy. Those accounts remain testimony rather than universal medical or legal instruction. The episode's worst material converts genocide, slavery, rape and a child character into porn-parody pitches; reverse-engineers unnamed partners from sexual clues; recommends purging, colonics, Herbalife and extreme weight loss; and pressures Heather through a phone-sex roleplay after she invokes her boyfriend, calls participation immoral and tries to stop. The archive preserves the accountability sequence but removes the explicit performance from the public layer. ACOG guidance corrects claims about hormonal contraception, pregnancy and STI protection; CDC guidance rejects 30 pounds in 30 days in favor of gradual weight loss; Poison Control guidance rejects inserting school glue into mucous membranes. Twenty-eight repeated `Medium` segments before the real opening are decoder hallucinations requiring clean/named regeneration. Named dialogue remains withheld.

Poison Control advises using art products according to their labels and not on skin or for food decoration unless labeled safe; mucous-membrane insertion is not endorsed: https://www.poison.org/articles/safe-use-of-art-products
